name: A1 · Iniciante
description: Do zero: se apresentar, verbo to be, cumprimentos, números e horas, família e casa, rotina no present simple e perguntas básicas.

flashcards.back: I am Ana. / I'm Ana. Contrações são normais no dia a dia.
I am · you are · he/she/it is · we are · you are · they are.
flashcards.en: I am, you are, he is, she is, it is, we are, they are.
flashcards.syl: ai âm, iú ar, ri iz, chi iz, it iz, uí ar, dêi ar

flashcards.back: I am 25 (years old). Em inglês usa-se to be, nunca 'have'.
Where are you from? Resposta: I'm from Brazil.
Morning = até o meio-dia · afternoon = até ~17h · evening = noite (ao chegar). Good night é só para despedida/dormir.
flashcards.en: Good morning! Good afternoon! Good evening!
flashcards.syl: gud MÓR-ning · gud éf-ter-NÚN · gud ÍV-ning

flashcards.back: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? / Pardon? / Could you say that again?
flashcards.en: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?
flashcards.syl: SÓ-ri, kén iú ri-PÍT dét plíz

flashcards.back: I don't understand. Também: 'I don't speak English very well.'
Excuse me = com licença / para chamar atenção. Sorry = desculpe (quando você errou ou esbarrou).
flashcards.en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
flashcards.syl: ex-KIÚZ mi, uér iz dâ BÉTH-rum

flashcards.back: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
flashcards.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
flashcards.syl: uân, tu, trí, fór, fáiv, siks, SÉ-ven, êit, náin, tén

flashcards.back: What time is it? Resposta: It's three o'clock. / It's 3:30.
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Sempre com maiúscula.

flashcards.en: This is my mom, my dad, my sister, and my brother.
flashcards.syl: dis iz mai mâm, mai déd, mai SIS-ter, end mai BRÂ-der

flashcards.en: This is my house, and that is your car.
flashcards.syl: dis iz mai ráus, end dét iz iór kar

flashcards.back: Verbo + -s (works, plays). Termina em -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o → -es (watches, goes). Consoante + y → -ies (study → studies).
flashcards.en: She works, he watches TV, it goes fast.
flashcards.syl: chi UÉRKS, ri UÓ-tchâz TI-VÍ, it GÔUZ fést

flashcards.front: Negativa e pergunta no present simple.
flashcards.back: I/you/we/they: don't + verbo. He/she/it: doesn't + verbo. Pergunta: Do/Does + sujeito + verbo?
flashcards.en: Do you like coffee? No, I don't.
flashcards.syl: du iú laik KÓ-fi · nôu, ai dôunt

flashcards.back: always · usually · often · sometimes · rarely · never. Ficam antes do verbo principal e depois do to be.
flashcards.en: I usually wake up at seven.
flashcards.syl: ai IÚ-ju-â-li uêik âp ét SÉ-ven

flashcards.front: Palavras de pergunta: what, where, when, who, why, how.
flashcards.back: o quê · onde · quando · quem · por quê · como.
flashcards.en: What, where, when, who, why, how.
flashcards.syl: uót, uér, uén, ru, uái, rau

flashcards.back: How much is it? / How much are they? (plural).

questions.question: Como se diz corretamente a sua idade (28)?
Escolha a forma negativa correta: He ___ a doctor.
Você chega a uma reunião às 19h. O que diz?
questions.explanation: À noite, ao chegar: Good evening. 'Good night' é despedida.

questions.question: Você não entendeu. Qual frase é adequada?
options: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?
questions.explanation: Pedir para repetir é essencial no A1.
questions.en: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?

questions.question: Você esbarrou em alguém. O que diz?
questions.explanation: Por erro/esbarrão: Sorry. 'Excuse me' é para chamar atenção ou passar.

questions.question: Qual é o dia depois de Friday?
My father's wife is my ___.
questions.explanation: A esposa do meu pai = minha mother (mãe).

questions.question: ___ are my keys. (estão perto de você)
Where is the TV? In the ___.
questions.explanation: TV fica na living room (sala de estar).

questions.question: I ___ drink coffee. (nunca)
questions.explanation: never = nunca. Vem antes do verbo principal.

questions.question: ___ is your name?
questions.explanation: 'What is your name?' = Qual é o seu nome?

questions.question: ___ is that woman? She's my teacher.
